title: Real-time Search with Debounce & Caching
description: Design real-time search with debounced intent, true request cancellation, stale-result suppression, complete cache keys, predictable UI states, and keyboard access.

seo.title: Real-Time Search Frontend System Design
seo.description: Design real-time search with debounced intent, AbortSignal cancellation, stale-result suppression, complete cache keys, recovery, and keyboard access.

premiumPreview.summary: Design responsive search with debounced intent, complete cache identity, real cancellation, and an independent stale-response guard.
learningOutcomes: Separate live input, accepted search intent, request runtime, and result state.
Build cache keys from query, locale, filters, sort, and permission scope.
Use AbortSignal to release work while generations protect UI correctness.
Preserve keyboard selection across loading, refresh, empty, and error states.
Tune debounce and cache policy from observed behavior rather than fixed rules.
premiumPreview.unlockDescription: Premium unlocks the request state machine, locale-race worked example, cache contract, accessibility behavior, and measurement plan.

sources.label: Blind: Meta frontend system design, March 2022
sources.note: One L5 Meta front end account describes a system design round that asked for a very specific component such as autocomplete rather than a whole product. This case practises that shape; it is not the reported prompt.

sources.label: LeetCode Discuss: Zalando senior frontend engineer interview, Berlin, July 2024
sources.note: One senior account describes a Codility search-box take-home followed by the question 'how can you optimise the application further?'. This case practises the design side of that discussion; it is not the reported prompt.

sources.label: enginebogie: Booking.com frontend engineer machine-coding round, May 2023
sources.note: One account lists debounce or throttle, caching, keyboard navigation and error states as the expectations of a 60-minute typeahead round. This case practises the design side of those expectations; it is not the reported prompt.

sources.label: LeetCode Discuss: Agoda senior frontend interview, Bangkok, July 2026
sources.note: The architecture round asked for a hotel search page with date, city and guest inputs, filters and result cards, built for a million users and multiple teams. This search case is a practice version of that round's search slice, not its wording.
